title: Double sums and ties vary with the parallel scan
verdict: double `SUM` and tie order vary run to run; integer sums do not
description: Over LINEITEM, a double `SUM` gave two different values in four runs, and the first rows of a sort over ties differed between two runs; the exact `NUMBER` sum never varies. Two identical `ROW_NUMBER` windows in one query numbered the rows alike. Small `VALUES` inputs run on one thread and do not show it.
reference: Bags; open orders and sums of doubles within their bounds. sverify's SQL refuses double sums and the model's list order.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT sum(l_extendedprice::FLOAT * l_discount::FLOAT) AS s FROM snowflake_sample_data.tpch_sf1.lineitem UNION ALL SELECT sum(l_extendedprice::FLOAT * l_discount::FLOAT) AS s FROM snowflake_sample_data.tpch_sf1.lineitem UNION ALL SELECT sum(l_extendedprice::FLOAT * l_discount::FLOAT) AS s FROM snowflake_sample_data.tpch_sf1.lineitem UNION ALL SELECT sum(l_extendedprice::FLOAT * l_discount::FLOAT) AS s FROM snowflake_sample_data.tpch_sf1.lineitem

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
